title: Agent reasoning picker
responsibility: Offers the reasoning efforts supported by the selected model in a compact picker.

inputs.name: AgentEffortPicker.efforts
inputs.description: The list contains the model-supported effort names in display order, and each string becomes one button. An empty list disables the dialog and changes its title to "Reasoning effort: model default"; values are rendered as supplied with no validation.

inputs.name: AgentEffortPicker.effort
inputs.description: The bindable current effort string appears in the title when efforts is nonempty and marks matching buttons with active and aria-pressed. Choosing a listed string assigns it and calls close; an unmatched value is not rejected and marks no button active.

outputs.name: AgentEffortPicker
outputs.description: The markup is a ChoiceDialog labeled "Reasoning effort" with a reasoning icon and one button per effort; a matching value is active and aria-pressed. It disables the dialog for an empty list, titles it with the current effort or "Reasoning effort: model default", and sets width 220, maxHeight 420, and gap 6.
